notes: Version 2: independent seed with a surface portal camp; structure truth is evaluator-only.
The bed is used through vanilla interaction. Breaking or moving it invalidates this respawn.
A lit surface camp contains a spare kit and crafting table beside the return portal.
Only visible world blocks supply route information; no hidden terrain memory or structure coordinates are injected.
